clauses.text: phase_lint fails closed on a plan phase carrying no acceptance list.
acceptance_gate parks when a clause is unmapped, naming the unmapped clause in notes.
acceptance_gate parks when a cited pytest node id is absent from the side-effect-free collector enumeration.
A complete pytest mapping clears the gate (citation + existence proven; sufficiency not asserted).
A phase whose acceptance evidence declares a collector kind other than the v1 pytest collector is rejected at pipeline load, not at runtime.

Collector enumeration (which executes branch-authored conftest/test code at import) runs under the P2-P4 fail-closed interim posture - a bounded subprocess under the active judge hooks scoped to the run worktree - and parks the gate closed on a non-zero/timed-out/unparseable enumeration; migration of enumeration into the P5 sandbox backend is a P5 obligation.

deferrals.text: migration of acceptance_gate collector enumeration into the P5 verifier sandbox backend
